name: configops
description: The undo and evidence layer for WordPress settings.

scripts.build:plugin: npm run build:ui && npm run check:release && bash build/package-plugin.sh
scripts.wp:reset: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && npm run wp:start
scripts.wp:cli: docker compose exec --user www-data wordpress wp --path=/var/www/html
scripts.wp:debug-log: docker compose exec --user www-data wordpress sh -lc 'touch /var/www/html/wp-content/debug.log && tail -f /var/www/html/wp-content/debug.log'
scripts.test:minimum: wp-playground-cli php --php=8.2 --wp=7.0 --mount=.:/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/configops -- /wordpress/wp-content/plugins/configops/tests/lint.php && wp-playground-cli php --php=8.2 --wp=7.0 --mount=.:/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/configops -- /wordpress/wp-content/plugins/configops/tests/run.php && wp-playground-cli php --php=8.2 --wp=7.0 --mount=.:/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/configops -- /wordpress/wp-content/plugins/configops/tests/adversarial.php && wp-playground-cli php --php=8.2 --wp=7.0 --mount=.:/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/configops --mount=tests/fixtures/configops-hostile-fixture:/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/configops-hostile-fixture -- /wordpress/wp-content/plugins/configops/tests/integration.php
scripts.test: npm run build:plugin && npm run check:ui-budget && npm run check:runtime-policy && npm run test:ui && npm run lint:php && npm run test:unit && npm run test:adversarial && npm run test:integration && npm run test:adapters
